sections.theory:
Change in cough

If there is a change in an old cough — it is mostly a persistent cough, during coughing a deep and heavy sound is produced, there is more than usual coughing, or blood and phlegm are coming with the cough — then consult a doctor. If in the family or among friends someone has the same problem, advise them too to consult a doctor as soon as possible.

Change in the process of breathing

Change in the process of breathing, i.e. difficulty arises in taking breath, because cancer is blocking the path of breath or a tumour is forming in the chest. If during work, while climbing stairs, the process of breathing is happening with difficulty, then do not ignore it.

Pain in the chest

Through lung cancer there is pain in the chest, shoulders and back. When pain begins in the chest, shoulders or back, then consult a doctor.

Headache

Headache is a sign of cancer spreading to the brain. But not all headaches are due to Metastasis in the brain. Sometimes the pressure of the lung tumour is on the superior vena cava. This is a large vein which brings dirty blood from the upper parts of the body towards the heart. Because of this pressure there is headache.
